in_sanskrit.name: Indrajeet
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Indrajeet is derived from the Sanskrit words ‘Indra’ meaning God of rain, thunder, and storm, and ‘jeet’ meaning victory. Thus, Indrajeet translates to the Victory of Indra.

in_marathi.name: Indrajeet
in_marathi.long_meaning: Indrajeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Indra, the Hindu god of rain, thunder, and power, bestows victory upon the one named Indrajeet.

in_bengali.name: Indrajeet
